setup.zh: 天亮了，雨停了。往沉鼎观的山路上，全是和你一样的孩子，背着包袱，眼睛亮得像刚擦过的碗。
setup.en: Day breaks; the rain has stopped. The path to Chending Temple is full of children like you, bundles on their backs, eyes as bright as bowls just wiped.

recap.zh: 上山路上，{伴}的包袱掉进了沟里。
recap.en: On the mountain path {伴}'s bundle fell into the ditch.

text.zh: 沟边蹲着一个和你差不多大的孩子，包袱掉进了沟底，急得脸通红。
text.en: By the ditch crouches a child about your age, bundle lost at the bottom, face red with worry.

text.zh: 别看了！……你、你能帮我够一下吗？
text.en: Stop staring! …C-can you help me reach it?

label.en: Climb down and fetch the bundle

exits.means: helps fetch the bundle from the ditch

text.zh: 你滑下沟，捞起包袱，两个人满身是泥爬上来。
text.en: You slide into the ditch, fish out the bundle, and the two of you climb out covered in mud.
The two of you arrive half a quarter-hour late.

text.zh: 你从沟边走了过去。身后那个孩子抬头看了你一眼——记住了你。
text.en: You walk on past the ditch. Behind you the child looks up at you once — and remembers you.

text.zh: 你准时到了山门。后来你才知道，那孩子叫{伴}。
text.en: You reach the gate on time. Only later do you learn the child's name: {伴}.
